candidate_program.name: global_cover_displacement
candidate_program.rationale: Estimates displaced opportunity by comparing covers after excluding only the root and after removing its closed neighborhood. Full active-graph partitions can respond to distant changes, but their difference is heuristic and two global cover computations may dominate runtime.
candidate_program.rule: weight - max(0, cover_displacement) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
